spans.s:
valá, m. prop. an encloser, and so
 —1.
(enclosure, i. e.) cave;
 —2. personified,
Vala, name of a demon who shuts up
the heavenly waters to withhold them
from man and is slain by Indra, 815, 7.
[√1vṛ, ‘enclose.’]

valavṛtra-niṣūdana, m. destroyer of
Vala and Vritra, i. e. Indra. [1264.]

valavṛtra-han [402], a. slaying Vala
and Vritra; as m. slayer of Vala and
Vritra, i. e. Indra. [1269.]
